scriptc.note: integration branch: merges the topic branches below, which are kept SEPARATE and each self-contained so any one can be sent upstream as its own PR without dragging the others along

topic_branches.fix/ffi-const-binding: a manifest-bound FFI call is dropped when its result initializes a never-reassigned local (upstream issue vercel-labs/scriptc#21)
topic_branches.fix/msvc-ssize-t: scr_runtime.h declares ssize_t function pointers; MSVC has no ssize_t, so any Windows build through that header fails to parse

canvas.source: build-libcanvas release (local out/ checkout wins when present)

webaudio.note: C++ graph compiled native by scripts/build-webaudio.sh; source is UNPATCHED (shim/emscripten.h and shim/wasm_simd128.h stand in for the two headers it wants), so a bump is a re-fetch. Pinned by FULL sha: actions/checkout cannot fetch an abbreviated one.
